question: Which Indian personality was given knighthood by the British monarch but it was returned by him after the Jallianwala massacre?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Rabindranath Tagore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore **returned knighthood after the Jallianwala massacre.
 
• The** eldest son of Debendranath Tagore** was** Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941).**
 
• In opposition to the** 1919 Amritsar Massacre, **which was so cruel that it killed at least 379 unarmed protesters in the **Jallianwala Bagh**, **Rabindranath Tagore returned **his knighthood for contributions to literature.
 
• **King George V knighted him in the 1915 Birthday** Honours, but following the **1919 Jallianwala Bagh massacre, **Tagore repudiated the honour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajagopalachari was among the first people** to be awarded the **Bharat Ratna, **the highest civilian honour in India. He also created the **Swatantra Party. **
 
• **Bipin Chandra Pal **was a supporter of Indian nationalism, a writer, an orator, a social reformer, and a **freedom fighter for the Indian** independence struggle. He was one of the** "Lal Bal Pal" trio's three members.**
 
• In the era of British colonial control in India,** Chittaranjan Das, also known as Deshbandhu,** was a lawyer, political activist, and liberation fighter for India. He also founded and served as the leader of the **Swaraj Party in Bengal.**
